Name: Granja La Pallaresa
Tips: 08:45 - the Gothic Quarter's granja lane. Thick xocolata amb xurros in a 1947 institution: marble tables, waistcoated waiters. Order the suís and share. Neighbouring Dulcinea is the same idea.

Name: Catedral de Barcelona (La Seu)
Cost Range: 16 EUR/pp, students under 25 14 EUR; a ~19 EUR tier bundles rooftop + audio/VR
Tips: 09:30 at opening, the quiet slot, ~1 hr. SAT TOURIST HOURS 09:30-17:15, last entry 16:30 (Sun is 14:00-17:00 only - another reason it is today). Crypt of St Eulalia below the altar, choir stalls bearing 1519 Golden Fleece arms, and 13 white geese in the cloister - one per year of Eulalia's life. TAKE THE ROOFTOP LIFT if it shows at the till.

Name: Plaça de Sant Felip Neri
Address: Plaça de Sant Felip Neri, 08002 Barcelona
Tips: 10:35 Gothic Quarter wander - the hidden square, still shrapnel-pocked from a 1938 bomb.

Name: Plaça Reial
Tips: 10:35 optional detour - palms and Gaudí lampposts. Also home to Los Tarantos if flamenco lands tonight.

Name: Basílica de Santa Maria del Pi
Cost Range: 8 EUR incl. crypt, museum, bell-tower climb
Tips: 11:00, ~25 min. Mon-Sat 10:00-20:00. Soaring single-nave Catalan Gothic with one of the world's largest rose windows. Set-time bell-tower climbs 11:00 / 12:30 - take one only if the timing is kind, the nave is the point.

Name: La Cova Fumada
Tips: 11:50 - BE AT THE DOOR BY 11:45. SATURDAY HOURS 09:00-13:00 SHARP and they stop when the food runs out. The 1944 family bar that INVENTED THE BOMBA. No sign on the door, CASH ONLY. Order bombas all round + the day's grilled fish + chickpeas with morcilla. AUGUST CAUTION: several trackers show a staff-holiday closure in parts of August - call +34 932 21 40 61 a day ahead.

Name: Bar Jai-Ca
Tips: BACKUP for La Cova Fumada, 2 min away. Since 1955 - bombas, la raspa anchovy bones, calamari. Open daily from 09:00.

Name: Basílica de Santa Maria del Mar
Cost Range: 5 EUR/pp cultural visit; rooftop combo 10 EUR
Tips: 13:30, ~25 min of cool stone. Mon-Sat 10:00-18:00. The Cathedral of the Sea, built by the port neighbourhood in just 54 years (1329-1383) - the purest Catalan Gothic interior in the city, all height and light, almost no ornament. Literally around the corner from the Picasso Museum.

Name: Picasso Museum
Tips: 14:00 - BOOK THE 14:00 SLOT NOW, Saturday is its busiest day and it sells out. Five medieval palaces, air-conditioned, Picasso's formative Barcelona years - the teenage academy work is the revelation. Summer Sat hours 09:00-21:00. 1-1.5 hrs. Not in the museum mood? Gelato and shaded Born alleys do the same job - the only rule is nobody stands on open sand 14:00-16:30.

Name: El Xampanyet
Tips: 15:45 optional, opposite the museum - the 1929 cava-and-anchovies bodega. CLOSED for its August staff holiday, reportedly reopening ~Aug 24-25 - peek in the window before queueing.

Name: Bar del Pla
Tips: Fallback if El Xampanyet is still shut - covers the vermouth-and-croquetas slot.

Name: Barceloneta Beach
Tips: 16:30 DELIBERATELY LATE - end-of-August UV peaks 12:00-17:00 and the beach is packed by 11:00; at 17:00 it is a completely different (better) day. Sand cooled, sea at its warmest ~24 C. Walk 15 min or L4 one stop, and notice the fishermen's grid of balconied lanes you cross - real Odessa energy. LIFEGUARDS OFF DUTY ~19:30. One adult always stays with the bags. Free cold showers along the boardwalk - pack a change of clothes and go straight to dinner.

Name: Font de Carmen Amaya
Tips: A 2-minute detour on the beach walk, a block back from the sand - the fountain honouring the greatest bailaora of the 20th century, born 1913 in the Somorrostro shanty-town that stood on this beach.

Name: Platja de Nova Icària
Tips: Calmer beach alternative two Metro stops up, with playgrounds.

Name: MNAC steps (Montjuïc)
Address: Palau Nacional, Parc de Montjuïc, 08038 Barcelona
Tips: ~19:50 sunset alternative (sunset 20:31) - leave the beach 19:15, L4 to Passeig de Gràcia, L3 to Espanya. Sunset from the grand staircase down the twin-towers axis, then a 15-min walk to Carrer de Blai. NOTE: Bunkers del Carmel does NOT work for sunset - fenced since 2023, cleared before sundown, fines for climbing in.

Name: Carrer de Blai
Tips: 21:00 - the fun, cheap dinner. A pedestrian street of pintxo bars where the kids pick their own skewers off the counters and you pay by the toothpick. Blai 9 and Tasca el Corral are the strong ends of the strip. Family food street, not a bar crawl. NOTE: neighbouring Quimet & Quimet is closed all August.

Name: El Born Centre de Cultura
Tips: WET FALLBACK for the 16:30-19:30 beach block - the 1714 city excavated under a splendid iron market roof, plus Born boutiques, then straight to Blai.

Name: Palau Dalmases
Tips: OPTIONAL tonight - candlelit baroque salon, ~70 seats, 3 min from both the Picasso Museum and Santa Maria del Mar, which are already on today's route. Nothing booked.
